Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: In the final step (Step 3), the Planner incorrectly concluded that Tom Seaver was the answer. The Planner relied on the WebSurfer's finding that Tom Seaver was in the "Greatest Sports Legends" series but failed to verify his Hall of Fame induction year. Tom Seaver was inducted in 1992, not 1993. The WebSurfer correctly identified in the previous step that Reggie Jackson was the *sole* inductee of the 1993 class. The Planner ignored this definitive fact in favor of an incorrect assumption about timing ("accounting for common election/induction timing offsets"), leading to the wrong final answer.
